text:
Marta: Quick sync — marketing needs final changelog + docs links for Friday's GTM cadence. Can we lock timing and any rollout constraints?
Alex: We can do doc publish at 10:00 PT but need final changelog reviewed by eng by 09:30.
Sam: Working on changelog now. Will paste PR link in 20m. Need to confirm whether we keep the old endpoint behavior note.
Kevin: FYI the canary window is tight — infra only has a 30m slot for the canary config after deploy. Prefer canary at 12:00 PT.
Marta: Okay — marketing wants the public post + benchmark narrative at 11:00 PT so we need docs at 10:00 and post at 11:00. Can we shift canary earlier?
Alex: We can do a warm canary at 10:30 with 5% traffic, then full canary at 12:00 with 20%. That gives marketing flags for the post.
Jen: I’ll own the webinar registration and thumbnail. Need final feature bullets and the benchmark graph by Thu 3pm.
Sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — added changelog + breaking note for batching config. Please review.
Docs-bot: CI passed for docs PR #482 (:white_check_mark:). Preview: https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/pr-482
Marta: Perfect, can we also include the benchmark narrative blurb? Short version: "2–3x latency improvement at 1k concurrent requests for quantized models, 20% cost reduction on average" — eng ok with wording?
Kevin: That phrasing is fine but change to "up to 2x" and add footnote about test harness. Suggest: "up to 2x median latency improvement at 1k concurrent requests (test harness conditions)"
Marta: Made the edit. Sam, accept?
Sam: Accepted. I'll update PR description and add the benchmark figure with caption.
Marta: For inbound leads routing — does sales want a separate landing or a UTM?
Alex: Use UTM params and route leads to hubspot form. Also set webhook to /webhooks/marketing-leads at the internal API gateway.
Marta: Can someone paste the full webhook URL and confirm access?
Kevin: Internal webhook: https://api.internal.redwood.ai/webhooks/marketing-leads (requires service token). I will add a short runbook for token retrieval.
Jen: Webinar slot confirmed for Tue 11/14 08:00 PT. I'll schedule invites once registration page is live.
Marta: Quick checklist I put together:
```
10:00 PT — docs publish (PR merged + preview live)
11:00 PT — marketing public post + benchmark deck published
11:05 PT — social posts + email blast
11:15 PT — inbound lead UTM + webhook live
12:00 PT — canary 20% (infra), monitor 30m
13:00 PT — full rollout if metrics OK
```
Marta: Tagging @Alex @Kevin please confirm you can hit these times. If not, call it out now. :eyes:
Alex: Confirmed on docs publish and post timing. I'll merge PR by 9:20 PT.
Kevin: Confirmed on canary timing and webhook. I'll run the runbook and drop notes in the ticket.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: canary-2026-11-14-12:00 (5% warm at 10:30). Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/canary-2026-11-14-12:00
Marta: Awesome. Sam/Jen — anything else you need from eng before we finalize copy and schedule?
Sam: Please add one line in changelog about "deprecated model alias behavior" and link to migration guide. Will update before 09:00 PT.
Jen: Need the benchmark SVG and alt text by Thu 3pm. Once in assets bucket, send the CDN path.
Marta: Great — I'll prepare the final post and share the embargo calendar. Thanks team :rocket:
